Package com.openvireo.core.java

Class JHosts

java.lang.Object
com.openvireo.core.java.JHosts
public final class JHosts extends Object
Builds a
invalid reference 
Host
from Java, and adapts between the Java Host interfaces and the generated (suspend) ones. Each part of a Host is either a Java one (JHttpTransport, JSecureStore, JBlobCache) or a shipped or Kotlin one (JavaNetHttpTransport, MemoryStore, FileCache, ...). JDefaultHosts.builder() starts with the platform's defaults filled in. 
Host host = JHosts.builder().http(myTransport).log((level, target, msg) -> {}).build();
